# Qualimetrix

> Fast PHP static analysis tool for code quality metrics. Requires PHP 8.4+.
> Install: `composer require --dev qualimetrix/qualimetrix`
> Run: `vendor/bin/qmx check src/`

Qualimetrix (Qualimetrix) analyzes PHP code and reports quality violations across complexity, coupling, cohesion, maintainability, size, design, architecture, code smells, and security.

Commands:

```
vendor/bin/qmx check <paths>                            # analyze code, report violations
vendor/bin/qmx rules                                    # list all rules with options
vendor/bin/qmx graph:export <paths> -o graph.dot        # export dependency graph (dot/json)
vendor/bin/qmx baseline:generate <file> [paths]         # capture current findings as a new baseline
vendor/bin/qmx baseline:update <file> [paths]           # tighten an existing baseline against current findings
vendor/bin/qmx baseline:cleanup <file> [paths]          # list/remove baseline entries nothing reports any more
vendor/bin/qmx baseline:explain <file> <subject>        # show a metric subject's effective boundary and its source
vendor/bin/qmx baseline:rename-channels <file> <map>    # rewrite baseline channel names along a declared rename map
vendor/bin/qmx directives [paths]                       # audit inline @qmx-* directives for stale/inert ones
vendor/bin/qmx debug:layer-assignment <fqn>             # show which architecture layer a class would be assigned to
vendor/bin/qmx hook:install                             # install git pre-commit hook
vendor/bin/qmx hook:uninstall                           # uninstall git pre-commit hook
vendor/bin/qmx hook:status                              # show git pre-commit hook status
```

Full option list per command: `qmx <command> --help`. Common `check` options:

```
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --detail                     # summary + violation list
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --format=text                # one line per finding, ordered by file
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --format=metrics             # raw metric values for all symbols
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --format=json                # structured JSON output
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --format=html -o report.html   # interactive HTML report
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --format=health               # text health scores table
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --report=git:main..HEAD      # violations from changed files only
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --namespace='subtree:App\Service'    # drill down into namespace
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --disable-rule=complexity.*   # disable a rule group (star required)
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --only-rule=coupling.cbo     # run specific rule
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --baseline=baseline.json     # ignore known violations
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --preset=strict              # built-in preset (also: legacy, ci; composable: --preset=strict,ci)
vendor/bin/qmx check src/ --fail-on=warning            # exit code threshold for CI (none|warning|error, default: error)
```

Output formats: `summary` (default), `text`, `json`, `checkstyle`, `sarif`, `gitlab`, `github`, `metrics`, `health` (text table), `html` (interactive treemap), `suppressed` (machine-readable composition of what was suppressed and why), `text-verbose` (deprecated, use `text --detail`).

Presets: `strict` (greenfield, tight thresholds), `legacy` (relaxed thresholds), `ci`. Composable: `--preset=strict,ci`.

Rule groups: `complexity`, `coupling`, `size`, `design`, `maintainability`, `cohesion`, `architecture`, `duplication`, `code-smell`, `security`. Full rule list with IDs, thresholds, and options: `qmx rules`.

Configuration: `qmx.yaml` (auto-discovered) or `--config=path`. Root keys: `paths`, `exclude`, `format`, `rules`, `disabledRules`, `onlyRules`, `suppressPaths`, `suppressNamespaces`, `failOn`, `cache`, `parallel`, `coupling`, `includeGenerated`, `includeAutoloadDev`, `memoryLimit`, `architecture`, `computedMetrics`, `excludeHealth`.

Suppression: `@qmx-ignore` / `@qmx-ignore-next-line` in docblocks or comments (symbol/line scope), `@qmx-ignore-file` (whole file). Threshold override: `@qmx-threshold` on a class/method.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](https://qualimetrix.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation in a single file — all rules, CLI options, configuration, output formats
- [Quick Start](https://qualimetrix.dev/getting-started/quick-start/): Installation, first analysis, pre-commit hook, GitHub Action, Docker
- [Configuration](https://qualimetrix.dev/getting-started/configuration/): YAML config format, rule options, exclude paths
- [CLI Options](https://qualimetrix.dev/usage/cli-options/): All command-line flags and options
- [Rules Overview](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/): All rules with IDs, default thresholds, and descriptions
- [Output Formats](https://qualimetrix.dev/usage/output-formats/): Format details, examples, and formatter-specific options
- [Git Integration](https://qualimetrix.dev/usage/git-integration/): Staged files, diff analysis, report scoping
- [Baseline](https://qualimetrix.dev/usage/baseline/): Ignoring known violations, baseline management
- [Default Thresholds](https://qualimetrix.dev/reference/default-thresholds/): Complete threshold reference table
- [GitHub Actions](https://qualimetrix.dev/ci-cd/github-actions/): CI/CD integration guide

## Optional

- [Complexity Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/complexity/): CCN, Cognitive, NPath, WMC — thresholds and configuration
- [Coupling Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/coupling/): CBO, Instability, Distance, ClassRank
- [Size Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/size/): Method count, class count, property count
- [Design Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/design/): DIT, NOC, type coverage
- [Maintainability Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/maintainability/): Maintainability Index
- [Cohesion](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/cohesion/): LCOM rule, TCC/LCC metrics
- [Architecture Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/architecture/): Circular dependency detection
- [Code Smell Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/code-smell/): Boolean args, eval, goto, god class, data class, unused private, etc.
- [Security Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/security/): SQL injection, XSS, command injection, hardcoded credentials
- [Duplication Rules](https://qualimetrix.dev/rules/duplication/): Code duplication detection
- [Remediation Time](https://qualimetrix.dev/reference/remediation-time/): Estimated fix time per rule
- [Other CI Systems](https://qualimetrix.dev/ci-cd/other-ci/): GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines
- [Usage Scenarios](https://qualimetrix.dev/usage/usage-scenarios/): Common workflows and use cases
